args.reason: Supplier Chidi (Chidi's Farm Produce) reports he has not received ₦250,000 for invoice INV-88 and has asked to be resent. The internal transfer TRF-INV-88 shows status "failed" (i.e., funds still recorded in the shop's balance, ledger unchanged), but a direct Access Bank verification reports the amount was credited to account 0234567891 on 2026-11-21 14:02 (bank ref 000014261121140211000088). Re-issuing without reconciliation risks double-paying the same invoice, which cannot be reversed. Need a human to reconcile the shop ledger balance against the bank credit, confirm whether the money is with Access Bank or retained, and then decide whether any re-send (and how to handle the duplicate) is appropriate.
